title: Equivalence field for native K-flat localization
statement: The localization construction induced by the native K-flat inclusion and the derived quotient is an equivalence once the quotient is known to invert the restricted quasi-isomorphisms.

source.place: Native tensor model, localization field; Stacks 06YS, 06YU and 0FPT

proof.text: Use the native K-flat replacement theorem to supply a quasi-isomorphism from a native K-flat complex to every complex, together with the right calculus of fractions for complex quasi-isomorphisms.

Apply the right-fraction dense-subcategory localization theorem to the ambient derived quotient and the native K-flat full subcategory. It gives an equivalence from the constructed restricted localization to the derived category, with an isomorphism after precomposition by the restricted localization functor.

The functor supplied by the dense-subcategory theorem is a localization lift of the restricted quotient. The universal lifting isomorphism identifies it with Localization.Construction.lift, so equivalence transports across this natural isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Native K-flat localization roof equivalence, using the dense full-subcategory right-fraction theorem and the native replacement/calculus input.
